spots.b2b_road: played yesterday and is on the road today (nba/nhl/ncaab)
spots.big_fav_off_loss: a 75%+ favorite coming off a loss
spots.early_season: one of the team's first 3 games of the season (mlb: first 10)
spots.home_after_trip: first home game after 3+ road games (mlb: 6+)
spots.off_blowout_loss: lost its last game by a blowout
spots.off_blowout_win: won its last game by a blowout
spots.off_bye: off a bye - 10+ days since its last game, mid-season (nfl/ncaaf)
spots.off_upset_loss: lost its last game as a 70%+ favorite
spots.off_upset_win: won its last game as a 30%-or-less dog
spots.rest_edge: rested while the opponent played yesterday (nba/nhl/ncaab)
spots.revenge: lost the last meeting with this opponent (this season or last)
spots.short_week: 5 or fewer days since its last game (nfl)
